lines.text: David sings to the LORD about Cush, a Benjamite, and asks to be saved or his pursuers will tear him to pieces.
David says that if he has rewarded his ally with evil, his enemy may trample him to the ground.
David asks the LORD to arise in anger and ordain judgment, with the assembled peoples gathered around Him.
David says his shield is with Jonathan, and that the righteous God searches hearts and minds.
If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword and ordains His spears with fire.
